assessment: Local storage/read diagnostic; no HTTP/Worker/LLM/Executor throughput claim

metric_notes.graph_ms: sum of timed initial/approval/event/replay calls including Python double and bounded file IO; excludes SQL capture, saver/full-graph probes, reopen and wait-reentry
metric_notes.logical_bytes: SQL checkpoint/metadata JSON text + unique serialized blobs + retained writes; not physical disk, WAL or Python heap
metric_notes.reopen: new pool + rebuilt graph + first full state read in same process; excludes old-pool close; not Pod/process or Jupyter restart
metric_notes.delta_reads: ancestor-history method invocations within measured trial and explicit probes; not SQL statement count
metric_notes.latest_bytes: encoded latest checkpoint and referenced blobs; Delta may require ancestor writes, so not full restored-state size
metric_notes.postchecks: followup reset/historical read checks run after captured bytes/times/call lists

stable_ancestor_reads.reason: no new ancestor queries for stable reducer
